title: Negative Equity Roll-In to Kestrel Auto Finance — Trade-In Agreements
content:
Negative equity on a **Trade-In Agreements** agreement can be carried by the Kestrel Auto Finance contract of the purchase the trade is applied to.

## Rule

Where the purchase order a trade is applied to is paid through a Kestrel Auto Finance contract and the grade allows roll-in, the part of the trade's negative equity that contract absorbs is recorded on the trade-in agreement as one covering entry for negative equity rolled into financing, dated the day it is recorded, and it raises the undistributed trade equity by its amount. The roll-in is recorded with the purchase order the trade is applied to, and whatever part of the negative equity it leaves uncovered is the customer's to pay. A Kestrel Auto Finance contract signed before the pickup inspection cannot show the shortfall the inspection settles, so the roll-in is recorded without waiting for the contract to itemise it.

## Business effect

| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| Agreement history | One covering entry for negative equity rolled into financing, naming the purchase order, dated the day it is recorded |
| Undistributed trade equity | Higher by the amount rolled in |
| Part not absorbed by the contract | Remains the customer's to pay |
| The finance contract itself | Not changed by the recording |

## Care console reference: `record_negative_equity_rollin_4688789d`

**Capability.** Records on one trade-in agreement the part of its negative equity absorbed by the Kestrel Auto Finance contract of the purchase the trade is applied to. One call books a covering entry of the kind `rolled_into_financing`, dated today, that names the purchase order whose finance contract carries the amount; the entry raises the agreement's undistributed trade equity by the amount given, so the shortfall still open on the agreement drops by that amount. The finance contract itself is not changed by this call.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `record_negative_equity_rollin_4688789d`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trade_in_id` | Reference number of the customer's trade-in agreement, as shown by the trade-in agreement lookup for this customer | Id |
| `purchase_order_id` | Reference number of the purchase order the trade is applied to, as shown on the trade-in agreement and by the purchase order lookup | Id |
| `rollin_amount` | The negative equity carried by the finance contract | USD, a positive amount to 2 decimal places (rounded to the nearest cent) |

**Return.** A text rendering of a receipt with `entry_id` (reference number of the new covering entry), `trade_in_id`, `settlement_method` (always `rolled_into_financing`), `purchase_order_id` (the purchase order named on the entry), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the amount recorded), `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `equity_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places, the undistributed trade equity with the entry booked; negative means a shortfall is still open). A receipt carrying an `entry_id` means the roll-in is recorded.

## Illustration (hypothetical receipt)

An agreement at an equity of -2600.00 on which 1900.00 is rolled in returns `equity_balance` -700.00: a shortfall of 700.00 is still open and is the customer's to pay.
